pages.title: Configuration, STEPPATH, Contexts and Trust
pages.purpose: Explain step path resolution, defaults.json, contexts/profiles, root certificates, and how defaults feed CA commands.
instructions: Cover $STEPPATH layout, contexts.json/current-context.json, defaults.json writing, ca-url/root/fingerprint resolution.

pages.title: Runtime Entrypoint and Command Routing
pages.purpose: Explain the binary entrypoint, urfave/cli app construction, plugin dispatch, and global error handling.
instructions: Cover process entry, STEPDEBUG behavior, exit codes, panic handling, and the command registry via cli-utils/command.

pages.title: X.509 Certificate Creation and Profile System
pages.purpose: Explain the certificate create/sign command family, profiles, templates, and key handling.
instructions: Cover profile leaf/intermediate/root-ca/self-signed, templates, KMS-backed keys, bundles, and trust store install.

pages.title: Crypto Toolkit and Key Material
pages.purpose: Explain the step crypto command group: JWT/JWS/JWE/JWK, KDF, OTP, nacl, keypair, and security gating.
instructions: Cover --insecure/--subtle gates, JOSE operations, KDF with scrypt/bcrypt/argon2, and key safety defaults.

pages.title: SSH Certificates and Agent Integration
pages.purpose: Explain step ssh flows: certificate, login, config, agent integration, hosts and proxycommand.
instructions: Cover SSH cert types, principal creation, agent add/remove, host-id and machine-id derivation.

pages.title: One-Time Token Flow and Provisioners
pages.purpose: Explain how OTTs are generated, the provisioner dispatch, token claims, and online vs offline modes.
instructions: Cover token validity constraints, audience per operation, confs cnf/sans claims, provisioner types JWK/OIDC/ACME/X5C/SSHPOP/etc.

pages.title: Plugins and ext kit
pages.purpose: Explain step-<name>-plugin resolution, KMS plugin invocation, and the step-kms-plugin integration.
instructions: Cover LookPath resolution, PATH and plugins dir, Windows handling, and well-known plugin URLs.

pages.title: Testing, Integration, and Operations
pages.purpose: Explain unit/integration test strategy, build tooling, and operational packaging (systemd, docker, packages).
instructions: Cover Go test categories, deployment packaging, and renewal orchestration via systemd timers.

pages.title: ACME Client Flow and Challenge Validation
pages.purpose: Explain the ACME client flow, order/authorization/challenge handling, and HTTP-01/device-attestation.
instructions: Cover standalone/webroot modes, LetsEncrypt special-casing, attestation, and challenge retry logic.

pages.title: CA Workflows: Init, Bootstrap, Sign, Renew, Revoke
pages.purpose: Explain the end-to-end CA workflows that combine tokens, clients, and offline/online modes.
instructions: Cover online vs offline clients, the CaClient interface, certificate/renewal flows, and deployment types.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical entry point: build, run, and try the step CLI, and map wiki pages to task routing.
instructions: Focus on how an engineer gets the tool built and running, the CLI routing model, and representative end-to-end examples.
